page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout, per the rules (e.g. "fi" = si, "fupra" = supra, "diffimiles" = dissimiles). Greek is uncertain in places and is not marked with [?]: "χ̄ρ" after εἰκόνας ἐμψύχως τῆς (probably Χριστοῦ or similar abbreviation), "ἐξοπτρον" (probably εἰσοπτρον), "ἀοράτυ" and "Θεῦ" (printed forms), and the accents on Ἠθικοὶ, ἠθῶν, and χαρακτηρισμὸς. Hebrew טבע appears twice as printed. The Greek should be checked against the scan. Printed abbreviations kept as printed: "&", "q;" none on this page. Printed "vitij", "vitae", "pracipere", "pracipit" kept as printed. Large text is set in roman with italic passages. Small mark at bottom right of the page is a stain or digitiser mark, not transcribed.
